purpose: lists the artifacts, environments, and deployments the forge holds

--text.description: prints the stages as text, even on a terminal

--json.description: the stages as one JSON object: stages, then each stage's document under its name, null for one that could not be read

--jq.description: the same JSON, formatted by jq for a person

--stages.description: prints the stages, one per line, in order, the same over any workspace

--marks.description: prints a mark per stage, as one JSON object, which changes when what the stage draws does: the forge's own mark of its runs, as a run makes each; environments' and deployments' also hold the forge's mark of their own kind, as another tool may deploy and a person may edit one

artifacts.description: {id, name, digest, size, run, age, expires}, keyed by its id, <run>/<id> on Azure DevOps: digest is the forge's, as sha256:…, null on GitLab and Azure DevOps, which show none; size in bytes; run the run that kept it; age seconds since it was made; expires when it goes, in seconds since the epoch, or null. GitLab names one for its job and its file. The name links to its page. GitHub reads its 100 newest and leaves out those expired, GitLab the archives of its 100 newest successful jobs, Azure DevOps those of its 20 newest runs, 100 at most; where there are more, the document is limited, at how many it drew

environments.description: {name, protection, approvers, branches}, keyed by its name: protection the kinds of rule that guard it, as reviewers, wait, branches, or deployers; approvers who may approve, by login; branches those that may deploy there, a tag's as refs/tags/…, null for any. GitLab names no branches, and a GitLab whose tier, or caller, cannot read protected environments leaves protection and approvers null. The name links to its page. GitHub reads the branch policies of 20 environments that have their own, and the list is limited before a 21st

deployments.description: {id, environment, ref, sha, state, actor, age}, keyed by its id: state is success, failure, running, waiting, cancelled, or inactive; actor who made it; age seconds since. environment links to its row in environments, row:environments/<name>, sha to the commit's page, and state to its log. Azure DevOps reads the newest 51 deployment records of each of the 20 environments changed last, and names each one's ref, commit, and actor from its run among the 100 newest; where there are more, the document is limited, at how many it drew

releases.description: a tab kit flow prints; on a terminal it opens in kittui, and with a form it is refused

builds.description: a tab kit flow prints; on a terminal it opens in kittui, and with a form it is refused
